summary.zh: 把 API 封装成 MCP 服务并校验工具定义
summary.en: Turn an API into an MCP server in Python or TypeScript.

description.zh: 从 OpenAPI 描述生成 MCP 工具，或从零搭出 Python、TypeScript 服务骨架，并校验工具定义是否符合规范。适合对外暴露内部 API、把自有系统接给助手使用。生成后仍需你配置运行环境和凭据。
description.en: Generates MCP tools from an OpenAPI spec, or scaffolds a Python or TypeScript server, then validates them against the protocol. Use it to expose an internal API or connect your own systems. Runtime and credentials are yours to set up.
